source.author: verg
source.text: Nullae hic insidiae tales; absiste moveri; nec vim tela ferunt; licet ingens ianitor antro aeternum latrans exsanguis terreat umbras, casta licet patrui servet Proserpina limen.
source.text_original: 'Nullae hic insidiae tales; absiste moveri; / nec vim tela ferunt; licet ingens ianitor antro / aeternum latrans exsanguis terreat umbras, / casta licet patrui servet Proserpina limen.
source.text_english: There are no such ambushes here; cease to be alarmed; nor do these weapons bring violence; though the huge doorkeeper, forever barking in the cave, bloodless, may frighten the shades, though chaste Proserpina guard her uncle’s threshold.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: in scrobibus cruor et largus Phlegethontis aperti stagnat honos, saevoque vocat grandaeva tumultu Thessalis exanimes atavos magnaeque nepotem Pleiones.
reuse.text_original: in scrobibus cruor et largus Phlegethontis aperti / stagnat honos, saevoque vocat grandaeva tumultu / Thessalis exanimes atavos magnaeque nepotem / Pleiones.
reuse.text_english: in the pits, blood and the abundant glory of open Phlegethon lie stagnant, and in savage uproar aged Thessaly calls the lifeless ancestors and the descendant of great Pleione.
